label: Mrknutí a úsměv
desc: Dýchá, pomalu mrkne, usměje se a podívá se do kamery. Nejjistější volba.
desc_en: Breathes, blinks slowly, smiles and looks into the camera. The safest choice.
style_tail: , static camera, soft natural light, photorealistic, natural motion
negative: blurry, low quality, watermark, text, distorted face, extra fingers, extra limbs, deformed hands

beats.prompt: she breathes gently, chest rising, and blinks slowly, loose strands of hair sway near her cheek, body otherwise still
a warm smile slowly spreads across her face, lips parting slightly, a small tilt of the head, then she holds the smile
she glances to the side and back to the camera, chin lifting a little, eyes bright, then settles into a calm gaze
